pages.text: A $(item)Phone PABX$() is the exchange every $(l:radiocraft:telephones/telephone)telephone$(/l) needs. Phones touching it or on its $(l:radiocraft:radios/data_wire)data wire$(/l) call each other by extension. It needs power from the power wire; its lamp is green while it has it.$(br2)Right click it to set it up: fill in the boxes and press Save.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Master number$(): dialed before an extension to reach this PABX. Three digits, or none (then only its own phones can call it); no two PABXes that reach each other share one.$(li)$(thing)First extension$(): its phones are numbered from here, 100 by default. Changing it numbers them all again.$(li)$(thing)PABX name$(): up to 10 letters, shown on a phone keying its master number.

pages.title: Calling other PABXes
pages.text: PABXes on one data wire, or across a $(l:radiocraft:microwave/microwave_radio)microwave link$(/l), reach each other. Dial the other PABX's master number, then the extension: master 603, extension 100 is $(thing)603100$(). An extension on your own PABX always wins.$(br2)A microwave radio alone is not an exchange: phones on it need a PABX too.
